purpose: Define the minimum canonical fields a project must expose before it becomes execution-eligible.

required_fields.name: slug
required_fields.purpose: Stable project identity across human, state, and queue surfaces.

required_fields.name: kind
required_fields.purpose: Distinguish client delivery, internal product, platform memory, research lane, or infrastructure lane.

required_fields.name: current_anchor
required_fields.purpose: Canonical repo, app, state surface, or owned path that grounds the dossier in present reality.

required_fields.name: owner
required_fields.purpose: Named accountable owner for planning and execution decisions.

required_fields.name: current_status
required_fields.purpose: Current lifecycle state such as active_delivery, planned, blocked, guided, or archive_reference.

required_fields.name: readiness
required_fields.purpose: Execution posture such as ready, guided, planned, blocked_on_infra_mapping, or reference_only.

required_fields.name: reason
required_fields.purpose: Short evidence-backed explanation for why the project is in its current posture.

required_fields.name: next_actions
required_fields.purpose: Bounded next steps; must not be a vague backlog dump.

required_fields.name: source_lineage
required_fields.purpose: Imported corpus, client contract, or internal origin lineage that explains where the project memory came from.

required_fields.name: execution_constraints
required_fields.purpose: Explicit boundaries that must hold before execution begins.
